title: Internet Identity-only role gate with principal-based admin user management (frontend)

requirements.summary: Remove credential-session gating and enter the app after Internet Identity sign-in, using backend principal-based role as the single authorization source; ensure logout clears Internet Identity session and cached protected data.
acceptanceCriteria: When signed in with Internet Identity, the app does not redirect to or render CredentialLoginPage.
The app’s route guards (e.g., RequireRole) use the backend role associated with the caller’s principal (not the credential session).
Logging out ends the Internet Identity session (or returns to the Internet Identity login screen) and clears cached role-protected data.

file_operations.description: Update the root auth gate to be Internet Identity-only: remove the credential-session check and any rendering/redirect to CredentialLoginPage; instead, wait for the caller role to load from the backend role function before rendering AppShell + routes. Keep profile-setup behavior intact after identity is available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: clear cached data on logout; treat anonymous as guest; handle authorization traps gracefully).

Refactor role hooks to use the backend-stored principal role as the single source of truth: make useGetCallerUserRole call the backend role getter (not getCurrentRole / credential session). Remove or deprecate useGetCurrentRole-driven credential gating usage. Ensure queries are keyed consistently so role changes and logout can invalidate/refetch. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: role-based access control UI expectations).

Replace credential-session logout with Internet Identity logout: call useInternetIdentity().clear() and clear React Query cache (queryClient.clear()) so protected data is removed and the UI returns to the Internet Identity login screen. Continue using the caller role query for nav filtering. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: on logout clear all cached app data including profile/role).

Add a safety-only UI update indicating credential login is no longer part of the standard flow (page should be effectively unreachable via the main gate). Keep user-facing text in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update Settings to list Internet Identity principals and allow admin-only role changes via backend APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings no longer shows mock employee credential data or mock alerts about a simplified credential system for this flow.
The Settings table loads from the backend list-users API and displays principal IDs and roles.
Changing a user’s role in the UI calls the backend update-role API and refreshes the table to show the new role.
Only admins can access Settings (existing route guard remains effective with the new role system).

file_operations.description: Replace the credential/employee mock management UI with Internet Identity principal user management: render a table of backend-known users (principal in monospace + current role) loaded from listUsers, and provide an admin-only role edit control that saves via changeUserRole then refreshes the list. Remove mock alerts and mock dialogs/forms (create employee, change password). Handle backend authorization errors by showing a user-friendly message. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: access-denied patterns and handling traps/errors gracefully).

Create dedicated React Query hooks for admin user management: a listUsers query and a changeUserRole mutation that invalidates/refetches both the users list and the current caller role (so UI updates after promotions). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: invalidate cached data after role changes; handle authorization failures).

requirements.summary: Unify navigation visibility and route protection to consistently use backend principal-based roles, and ensure role changes update UI without hard refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: Non-admin users cannot see admin-only nav items and receive an access-denied screen if they manually navigate to admin-only routes.
Admin users can see and access admin-only routes.
Role-dependent UI updates correctly after a role change (e.g., after promoting a user, admin-only nav items appear without a hard refresh once queries are invalidated/refetched).

file_operations.description: Ensure RequireRole relies exclusively on the principal-based role query (useGetCallerUserRole) and treats missing/guest roles as unauthorized, rendering AccessDeniedScreen. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: access control UI behavior; anonymous treated as guest).

Confirm nav filtering uses the same principal-based role source as RequireRole and updates when role query invalidates/refetches (e.g., after a role change). Ensure no admin-only links appear for non-admins. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: role-based nav visibility).

Ensure role-change mutation invalidates the caller role query key(s) used by AppShell/RequireRole so role-dependent UI updates immediately without hard refresh. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing (authorization: cache invalidation after role change).
